properties.name: app.version
properties.description: Application version string surfaced to clients (defaults to the Maven project version).

properties.name: app.data-dir
properties.description: Base directory for the SQLite database, logs and runtime data.

properties.name: app.static-dir
properties.description: Directory served as static web assets.

properties.name: app.base-url
properties.description: Public base URL this application is reached at (used for links and redirects).

properties.name: app.cookie-secure
properties.description: Whether the session cookie sets the Secure flag (enable behind HTTPS).

properties.name: app.trusted-proxy
properties.description: IP address of a trusted reverse proxy whose X-Forwarded-For header is honoured.

properties.name: app.session-cookie-name
properties.description: Name of the session cookie.

properties.name: app.default-admin-email
properties.description: Email of the admin user seeded on first boot.

properties.name: app.default-admin-password
properties.description: Password of the admin user seeded on first boot.

properties.name: app.default-user-password
properties.description: Default password for non-admin users seeded on first boot.

properties.name: app.ollama-base-url
properties.description: Ollama base URL override (used by the test profile).

properties.name: app.whisper-enabled
properties.description: Whether the bundled local Whisper speech-to-text server is started.

properties.name: encryption.key
properties.description: Symmetric key used to encrypt secrets at rest (connector credentials, API keys).

properties.name: ollama.url
properties.description: Base URL of the Ollama server used for local model inference.

properties.name: rag.enabled
properties.description: Enable retrieval-augmented generation over indexed documents.

properties.name: rag.top-k
properties.description: Number of nearest document chunks retrieved per RAG query.

properties.name: rag.similarity-threshold
properties.description: Minimum cosine similarity for a document chunk to be included in RAG context.

properties.name: functions.enabled
properties.description: Enable model function/tool calling.

properties.name: loki.enabled
properties.description: Enable shipping application logs to a Grafana Loki endpoint.

properties.name: loki.url
properties.description: Grafana Loki push API endpoint.

properties.name: spring.ai.enabled
properties.description: Project-level flag toggling Spring AI integration (the app's LLM layer is otherwise bespoke).
